disclaimer.title: Security Notice
disclaimer.runModeIntro: {{appName}} runs AI coding agents by default in
disclaimer.runModeAccess: mode, granting them full access to execute code and run commands on your system.

betaWorkspaces.title: Try the new interface
betaWorkspaces.intro: We've rebuilt the {{appName}} interface from the ground up, and you've been invited to try it out.
betaWorkspaces.description: The new interface is optimized for everyday work: managing agents, previewing changes, and reviewing code. It also unlocks features that weren't available in the old interface:
betaWorkspaces.newFeatureEditRepos: Edit multiple repositories at the same time
betaWorkspaces.newFeatureMultipleAgents: Run multiple agent conversations in a single workspace (even across different agents)
betaWorkspaces.newFeatureCommandBar: Navigate faster with the command bar
betaWorkspaces.remainingIntro: For now, some features remain in the current interface:
betaWorkspaces.transition: During the transition over the coming weeks, you'll be able to switch between the two interfaces.
betaWorkspaces.optOut: Want to opt out? You can switch back to the current interface anytime in settings.

crashReport.title: Crash report from the previous run
crashReport.description: The app crashed during its previous run. Below is the full report stored on this machine — submitting it is entirely your call.
crashReport.privacyNote: The report only lives on this machine. “Submit on GitHub” copies the full report to your clipboard and opens a prefilled GitHub issue in the browser (long reports are truncated — paste from the clipboard to complete). If you don't click, nothing leaves this machine.
